privacy.p: We collect information you provide when you submit an application or inquiry, create an account, or enrol in a program, such as your name, email, phone number, address and program preferences.
We use your information to process applications, deliver courses, track your learning progress, communicate with you about admissions and tuition, and improve our services.
We send transactional emails such as application confirmations and approval notices. We will never ask you for your password or payment card details by email.
Tuition is paid manually by bank transfer. We do not collect or store credit card numbers on this website. Payment records we keep relate only to amounts received against your tuition.
We do not sell your personal information. Faculty can view the contact details and progress of students enrolled in their own courses solely for teaching and support purposes.
We take reasonable measures to protect your information. Passwords are stored in hashed form and access to student and applicant data is restricted to authorised staff.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us.

terms.p: By accessing or using the Eagle Generation Bible School website, student portal, or any of our programs, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
Enrolment in a program is confirmed once your application is approved by our admissions team. Course content, schedules and materials are provided for your personal, non-commercial educational use.

Tuition is paid manually by bank transfer. Once your application is approved, our admissions team will email you the bank details and payment instructions. Fees are due as communicated at the time of approval and are non-transferable to another person.

Students are expected to uphold Christian character, honesty and respect in all interactions with faculty and fellow students. We reserve the right to suspend or withdraw access for conduct that is unlawful or contrary to the values of the school.

Certificates of completion are issued upon successful completion of a program and are a recognition of study with Eagle Generation Bible School. They do not constitute an accredited academic degree unless expressly stated.
All course materials, text, graphics and logos are the property of Eagle Generation Bible School or its licensors and may not be reproduced or redistributed without written permission.
We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of our services after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
